claims.text: A sealed lag label is a hashed hypothesis of when a notice seemed to arrive. The label is not a clock reading.
A millisecond, a Date read, or a performance clock refuses the hash. The held number is not a discrete-perception proof.
The signal field stays refused. A model of attention is not the body signal and not a sender.
The disconfirm line is what would show the lag was a story. It does not fill the raw present.
